items.name: Fintype.card_pi
items.type: {ι : Type u_4} {α : ι → Type u_6} [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] [(i : ι) → Fintype (α i)] : Fintype.card ((i : ι) → α i) = ∏ i, Fintype.card (α i)

items.name: Fintype.card_fun
items.type: {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [DecidableEq α] [Fintype α] [Fintype β] : Fintype.card (α → β) = Fintype.card β ^ Fintype.card α

items.name: Fintype.card_pi_const
items.type: (α : Type u_7) [Fintype α] (n : ℕ) : Fintype.card (Fin n → α) = Fintype.card α ^ n
